env.name: IVN_LIBRARY_APP
env.about: Your app's id in the App library, in lower case with underscores: for the prefix ACME KSC, acme_ksc. Each retailer that installs your app connects with a key that names this id.

env.name: KSC_PREFIX
env.about: The prefix your app's names in the retailer's iVendNext start with, in capitals: the --prefix you gave start.py (for example ACME KSC).

env.name: KSC_PAGE_URL
env.about: Where the kitchen's screens reach this service's page (https://kitchen-screen.example.app). Each screen's link points there.
